title: Forecrew project profile
description: Schema of .forecrew/profile.yaml, written by the onboarding analyst and approved by a human through a profile_approval gate. The analyzer drafts it from repo facts (internal/analyzer).

needLabel.description: Worker label a job needs: an OS or a toolchain.

summary.description: What the project is and does, in a few sentences.

components.description: Main parts of the codebase: a directory with its own build file, with how to build and test it.

path.description: Directory of the component, relative to the repo root, forward slashes. "." is the root.

stack.description: Main build stack of the component: go, node, rust, python, java, cmake, make or docker.

manifests.description: Build files found in the component, relative to the repo root.

build.description: Command that builds the component. Empty when unknown.

test.description: Command that runs the component's tests. Empty when unknown.

platforms.description: OS labels the component builds or tests on.

needs.description: Worker labels a job needs to build or test the component.

platforms.description: Operating systems and targets the project builds or runs on; become worker labels jobs need.

services.description: External services needed to build or test (databases, queues, ...), including docker-compose services.

file.description: File that declares the service, relative to the repo root.

ci.description: How CI runs and which checks gate a merge.

workflows.description: Workflow files, relative to the repo root.

runners.description: Raw runner values from runs-on and matrix OS entries, e.g. ubuntu-latest.

gating_checks.description: Checks that must pass before a merge. Unknown from the repo alone; the onboarding analyst asks the human.

agent_instructions.description: Instructions every agent working on the repo must follow.

suggested_roles.description: Role adjustments for this project (write paths, tools, tiers).

write_paths.description: Paths the role may write, relative to the repo root.

tier.description: Model tier for the role: fast, strong or best.

open_questions.description: Questions the analyst could not answer from the repo, for the human to resolve.

integrations.description: Tools the team uses outside the repo, found by onboarding from the repo and GitHub metadata (MCP configs, links, autolinks, files, CI steps, issue keys) and approved by a human in the profile PR. Connecting one that needs credentials is always a human step; nothing here is ever a secret.

tool.description: The tool: one of a fixed vocabulary, or mcp:<name> for an MCP server found in an MCP config.

instance.description: Host or organization (acme.atlassian.net, acme), or for an MCP server its URL host or command. Never credentials, user info or a full URL.

uses.description: What Forecrew could use it for.

location.description: File relative to the repo root, or github:<what> for GitHub metadata.

count.description: How many times it was seen there.

confidence.description: high: an MCP config or autolink; medium: several links or files; low: one link or a guess.

mapping.description: For knowledge tools: knowledge section to the locations it maps to (folders, spaces, pages).

status.description: proposed by onboarding, approved by a human in the profile PR, connected once credentials are set up.
